boundedProbe.interpretation: The 50-page bounded probe completed successfully and materially strengthens the cadence case. It confirms broad access to TCC-relevant public-web data without any observed error in this sample. It does not by itself prove national pagination completeness, operator identity uniqueness, long-run stability, or historical membership in the legacy 618 inventory.

cadenceDecision.reason: A 50-page bounded probe completed successfully in about 104 seconds with 1,458 matched stations, 1,303 carrying prices and all 1,458 carrying availability/REVE data. This is fast enough to justify a larger controlled pagination/identity validation step.
cadenceDecision.nextSafeAction: Before any full national sweep, persist explicit checks for unique location IDs, duplicate/page overlap, stable operator labels and pagination continuity on a larger but still bounded sample. Current-REVE identities must remain separate from historically proven legacy-618 labels.

safetyDecision.reason: The endpoint remains undocumented/unsupported and semantic parity with the documented external API is not complete. Keep the official external API authoritative until coverage, stability and mapping validation are sufficient.
